failed_attempt.stage_reached: source loading before daily feature, signal, trade, return, control or gate computation
failed_attempt.authorization_note: This was an unintended fail-closed parser contact, not an authorized holdout evaluation; it is recorded rather than hidden.

repair.rule: Before opening a data/kline_fetched current-cache CSV, parse its immutable filename row-count receipt. Skip the path if it contains fewer than 30000 15-minute rows. Explicit preholdout archive paths bypass this gate.
repair.reason: The universe snapshot was frozen on 2026-09-03. 30000 15-minute rows span 312.5 days, which conservatively covers both the tail after the 2026-05-01 safe end and the preregistered 140 complete-day minimum. The check occurs without opening the OHLCV file.
repair.short_source_effect: Data-quality exclusion only; no replacement symbol, context threshold, entry, exit, cost, sizing or acceptance gate changes.
repair.retry_condition: This amendment, the repaired script and its test must be committed before confirmation A is retried.
